blocks.text: Garth Harmsworth, Mick Park and Dean Walker’s 2005 Motueka case study described Explore Tasman as a comprehensive, read-only council intranet GIS. It held maintained resource, administrative, property, aerial and base information; approved outside users could connect over the internet using a static IP address. The report noted slow access without broadband and limited printing, querying and analysis. For Motueka iwi resource-management practitioners, the viewer provided background information and could avoid buying duplicate base data. The council was preparing Version 2 with planning maps and upgraded archaeological information.
